supersedes: run_04/VERIFICATION_CONTRACT.json (contract_version 4.1.0) -- same architecture and same 100,000-replicate stabilized bootstrap standard, applied from the START (run_04 learned this lesson mid-run; run_05 adopts it as frozen from the outset, per RUN04_PROBLEM_AUDIT/BOOTSTRAP_STABILIZATION_NOTE).
purpose: Decisive independent final verification for (a) continuous frontier candidates located in SEARCH_CONTRACT.json Phases A-C, and (b) the 1 kg/m3 integer cement profile in Phase D.
acceptance_rule: R_LCB95 >= 0.9 for targets strength >= 18.0 MPa and permeability >= 13.0 mm/s
r_lcb95_definition: min(mc_wilson_lower_95, calib_bootstrap_R_LCB95): Wilson one-sided 95% lower bound for Monte-Carlo sampling error at the tested N (primary point estimator: one paired residual draw per manufacturing scenario, row-weighted over the 650-row bank -- STATISTICAL_ESTIMAND.md, unchanged from run_04); 5th percentile of the CORRECTED 36-source-study cluster bootstrap (src/cluster_bootstrap.py, unchanged) at the STABILIZED replicate count below.
bootstrap_rep_count_note: run_04 discovered that 500 replicates gives a cluster-bootstrap 5th-percentile estimate with cross-seed sd~0.0014 for a near-boundary candidate -- enough to flip a PASS/FAIL decision on a small margin (BOOTSTRAP_STABILIZATION_NOTE.md). run_05 uses 100,000 replicates (cross-seed sd~0.00006-0.00009) for EVERY decisive candidate from the start -- no separate 500-replicate first pass is run in this run.

escalation_rule.step_2: N=50000, 100000 bootstrap reps, NEW manufacturing seed.
escalation_rule.step_3_condition: abs(R_LCB95 - 0.9) <= 0.002 at step 2 AND the pass/fail decision could still flip
escalation_rule.step_3: N=100000, 100000 bootstrap reps (hard cap on scenarios; bootstrap-rep count already at its production standard), NEW manufacturing seed.
escalation_rule.seeds: each escalation step uses a NEW seed, independent of every search-stage seed in SEARCH_CONTRACT.json and every other decisive candidate's seed.

efficiency_requirement: The expensive forward-model pass (mu_S, mu_logQ, s_S, s_logQ, support) is computed EXACTLY ONCE per (candidate, n_scenarios) pair, chunked into batches of 10,000 rows per src/efficient_verification.py's PREDICT_CHUNK_SIZE (run_04 OOM fix, PREDICTION_CHUNKING_NOTE.md, reused unchanged) to avoid the frozen model's O(N^2) memory blowup at N>=50,000. The cluster-bootstrap per-residual-row pass probability is computed exactly once per (candidate, n_scenarios) pair; all 100,000 bootstrap replicates reuse it via O(36)-per-replicate reweighting (src/cluster_bootstrap.py, unchanged).
paired_residuals: strength and log-permeability residuals are always drawn as a PAIRED row from tables/paired_residual_bank.csv, never independently.
reporting_precision: Rhat and R_LCB95 reported to 3 decimal places in manuscript-facing prose; full machine precision retained in CSV/JSON. Cement reported at 1 kg/m3 engineering resolution in the final headline result; the continuous frontier is reported without fabricated sub-kg/m3 precision.
independence_from_search: Every scenario/residual/bootstrap seed used in decisive verification (base 960000 series, see below) is disjoint from every search-stage seed in SEARCH_CONTRACT.json (205609151, 205609201, 205609301, 205609401).
decisive_verification_seed_base_scheme: seed_base = 1000000 + SHA-256(stable candidate ID) modulo a 63-bit reserved range. Candidate IDs are required and recorded in each trace. Before a run, the driver fails closed if its base matches a trace for another ID; the 201 following values are reserved for its N=20k, 50k, and 100k streams. This prevents same-cement continuous or integer candidates from reusing a final-verification stream.
seed_base_note: each candidate's base seed feeds decisive_verify(seed=base) at N=20000 (mfg seed=base, residual seed=base+1, cluster-bootstrap seed=base+2); escalation to N=50000 uses base+100, to N=100000 uses base+200. The 63-bit base allocation keeps each actual candidate stream separate and is disjoint from every search-stage seed.
generated_target_contract: TARGET_CONTRACT.json is authoritative for this run
